question.questionText: I highly recommend your products to __________
question.explanationHtml:
Detailed Explanation:
The blank in the sentence 'I highly recommend your products to __________' requires a pronoun that refers to people. The phrase 'recommend ... to' is commonly followed by a plural pronoun when talking about people in general. 'Others' is the correct plural pronoun to refer to other people in this context.
  • other (adjective): 'Other' is an adjective and cannot stand alone as a pronoun in this context.
  • another (pronoun/adjective): 'Another' is a singular pronoun or adjective, meaning 'one more' or 'an additional one', which does not fit here because we are talking about people in general (plural).
  • others (pronoun): 'Others' is a plural pronoun, meaning 'other people' or 'other ones', which fits the context of recommending products to other people.
  • the other (pronoun/adjective): 'The other' is used to refer to the second of two items or people, or the remaining one, which is not suitable here.
Related structure or vocabulary: recommend ... to + pronoun (others); 'others' as a plural pronoun referring to people in general

  • other (tính từ): 'Other' là tính từ, không thể đứng một mình như một đại từ trong trường hợp này.
  • another (đại từ/tính từ): 'Another' là đại từ hoặc tính từ số ít, nghĩa là 'một cái/người khác', không phù hợp vì ở đây nói về nhiều người (số nhiều).
  • others (đại từ): 'Others' là đại từ số nhiều, nghĩa là 'những người khác', phù hợp với ngữ cảnh giới thiệu sản phẩm cho những người khác.
  • the other (đại từ/tính từ): 'The other' dùng để chỉ cái/người còn lại trong hai cái/người, không phù hợp trong trường hợp này.
Cấu trúc và từ vựng: recommend ... to + đại từ (others); 'others' là đại từ số nhiều chỉ người nói chung

question.explanationHtml:

The blank in the sentence 'Through social network, users have new ways to connect to __________' requires a phrase or word that correctly completes the idea of people connecting with each other. The phrase 'connect to' is typically followed by a noun or pronoun referring to people. In this context, 'one another' is the most appropriate because it means 'each other', emphasizing mutual connection among users.
  • the other (pronoun/adjective): 'The other' is used to refer to the second of two things or people, or the remaining one in a specific group. It is not suitable here because the sentence refers to users in general, not just two people.
  • the others (pronoun): 'The others' refers to the remaining people or things in a group. It is usually used when the group is already specified. In this context, it is not as natural as 'one another' for expressing mutual connections.
  • other (adjective): 'Other' is an adjective meaning 'different or additional'. It cannot stand alone after 'to' in this sentence.
  • one another (reciprocal pronoun): 'One another' is a reciprocal pronoun used to indicate that each member of a group does something to or for the other members. It is the best choice here to express mutual connection among users.
Related structure or vocabulary: Reciprocal pronouns: 'each other' and 'one another' are used to show that two or more people do the same thing to each other. Structure: connect to one another = connect with each other.

question.questionText: The spreading of disease in Columbia is higher than ____________ in Brazil.
question.explanationHtml:
Detailed Explanation:
In this sentence, we are comparing the spreading of disease in Columbia with that in Brazil. When making comparisons, especially when referring to a previously mentioned noun (in this case, 'the spreading of disease'), we use 'that' as a pronoun to avoid repetition. 'That' refers back to 'the spreading of disease' in Brazil.
  • this (pronoun): 'This' is a demonstrative pronoun used to refer to something near in time or space, but it is not used for comparisons like this.
  • that (pronoun): 'That' is a demonstrative pronoun used to refer to something previously mentioned or at a distance. In comparisons, 'that' is used to avoid repeating a singular noun phrase.
  • these (pronoun): 'These' is the plural form of 'this', used for plural nouns, which does not fit here because 'the spreading of disease' is singular.
  • those (pronoun): 'Those' is the plural form of 'that', used for plural nouns, which does not fit here because 'the spreading of disease' is singular.
Related structure or vocabulary: In comparisons, use 'that' to refer back to a singular noun and 'those' for plural nouns to avoid repetition. Example: The price of this car is higher than that of the other car.

Cấu trúc và từ vựng: Đại từ sở hữu (possessive pronouns) dùng để chỉ quyền sở hữu. Cấu trúc 'of + đại từ sở hữu + kind' thường được dùng để so sánh hoặc xác định loại.

Tạm dịch: Dòng sản phẩm mà họ ra mắt mùa hè năm ngoái là dòng sản phẩm tiên tiến nhất trong số các dòng sản phẩm cùng loại của họ.

Detailed Explanation:
The blank in the sentence requires a possessive pronoun to indicate ownership of the product line. The phrase 'of ________ kind' means 'of their kind', referring to the type or category of the product line. Since the subject is 'the line of products they launched', the correct possessive pronoun to refer back to 'they' is 'their'.
  • hers (possessive pronoun): Possessive pronoun for 'she', used to indicate something belongs to a female person.
  • ours (possessive pronoun): Possessive pronoun for 'we', used to indicate something belongs to the speaker and others.
  • yours (possessive pronoun): Possessive pronoun for 'you', used to indicate something belongs to the person being spoken to.
  • their (possessive pronoun): Possessive pronoun for 'they', used to indicate something belongs to a group of people or things.
Related structure or vocabulary: Possessive pronouns are used to show ownership. The structure 'of + possessive pronoun + kind' is commonly used to compare or specify types.
